propertyTypes.name: Single-family house
propertyTypes.overrideReason: Broad evidence base is genuine here — assessment, disclosure and tax claims all apply directly.

propertyTypes.name: Rental / unwanted rental
propertyTypes.note: Deposit liability transfers on sale (6-321(3)); disclosure applies to non-owner-occupied rental.

propertyTypes.name: Small multifamily (2-4 units)
propertyTypes.note: Assessor treats up to four units as residential; disclosure act covers 1-4 dwelling units. Clean boundary.

propertyTypes.name: Multifamily, any size
propertyTypes.overrideReason: The business buys these at ANY size without qualification. No multifamily-specific Idaho evidence exists yet, so the grade reflects what a PAGE could source, not what we will acquire.
propertyTypes.note: OWNER-CONFIRMED 2026-09-10: four units or four hundred, without qualification. Note the STATUTORY boundary is unrelated to appetite — Ada County routes 5+ units to commercial appraisers and Idaho disclosure covers 1-4 dwelling units, so residential evidence stops at four even though acquisition does not.

propertyTypes.name: Manufactured / mobile home
propertyTypes.note: 63-304 conversion test is decisive and well evidenced.

propertyTypes.name: Vacant land / lot
propertyTypes.note: Irrigation, water and subdivision evidence is strong.

propertyTypes.name: Acreage / rural property
propertyTypes.note: Domestic water cap, septic authority and irrigation districts all evidenced.

propertyTypes.name: Development land
propertyTypes.note: 42-111 excludes subdivisions from domestic water — a real constraint. Land-use subdivision thresholds NOT yet researched per city.

propertyTypes.name: Infill lot
propertyTypes.note: Star's one-time administrative split is evidenced; other cities' rules are not.

propertyTypes.name: Problem / difficult property
propertyTypes.note: Floodplain permits and private roads evidenced for unincorporated county; easement evidence is thin.

propertyTypes.name: Flood-affected property
propertyTypes.note: Boise's three flood sources and Ada's permit requirement evidenced; parcel-level determination is explicitly out of scope.

propertyTypes.name: Fire-damaged / WUI property
propertyTypes.note: Boise WUI-O overlay evidenced. No evidence for other cities — do not assume.

propertyTypes.name: Office buildings
propertyTypes.note: OWNER-CONFIRMED acquisition target (2026-09-10). NO Idaho commercial evidence gathered — may be sold as a service, may not yet be written about as a page.

propertyTypes.name: Industrial / warehouse / flex
propertyTypes.note: OWNER-CONFIRMED acquisition target (2026-09-10). NO Idaho industrial evidence gathered.

sellerSituations.name: Inherited property
sellerSituations.note: 15-3-711 PR power + 55-2505(7) fiduciary disclosure exemption. Strongest evidenced situation.

sellerSituations.name: Probate sale
sellerSituations.note: PR power without court order, qualified by 15-3-715. Treasurer is ex officio public administrator.

sellerSituations.name: Foreclosure / behind on payments
sellerSituations.note: 120-day trustee sale notice, publication and service all evidenced.

sellerSituations.name: Property tax delinquency
sellerSituations.note: 3-year tax deed clock + 14-month double-gated redemption. Distinct from foreclosure and heavily evidenced.

sellerSituations.name: Selling with tenants
sellerSituations.note: Deposit liability transfers; one-year lease carve-out in the recording act.

sellerSituations.name: Bad tenants / unauthorized occupants
sellerSituations.overrideReason: 6-310A is well evidenced but excludes former tenants and family members, which is most of what sellers mean. Narrower than the topic count suggests.
sellerSituations.note: 6-310A evidenced but narrowly — excludes former tenants and family. Easy to misuse.

sellerSituations.name: Divorce
sellerSituations.overrideReason: The only divorce-specific evidence is one disclosure exemption, which covers spouse-to-spouse transfers ONLY. Idaho community property treatment of real property is unresearched.
sellerSituations.note: Only the disclosure exemption is evidenced, and it covers spouse-to-spouse transfers ONLY. Idaho community property treatment NOT researched.

sellerSituations.name: Vacant property
sellerSituations.note: Code enforcement is unincorporated-only. City-side enforcement not researched.

sellerSituations.name: Code violations
sellerSituations.note: County process evidenced end to end; city processes are not.

sellerSituations.name: Major repairs / as-is
sellerSituations.note: Disclosure duty applies by default — the honest angle competitors get wrong.

sellerSituations.name: Liens and judgments
sellerSituations.overrideReason: The `liens` topic is tagged loosely across unrelated claims. No lien- or judgment-specific research has been done.
sellerSituations.note: Not researched as a topic in its own right.

sellerSituations.name: Relocation
sellerSituations.note: No Idaho-specific evidence needed or gathered.

sellerSituations.name: Fire damage
sellerSituations.note: WUI overlay is about construction, not damaged-property sale. Weak fit.
